statement_en: Is it true that, for every $k\geq 3$, there is a constant $c_k>0$ such that\[\mathrm{ex}(n,G_k) \ll n^{3/2-c_k},\]where $G_k$ is the bipartite graph between $\{y_1,\ldots,y_k\}$ and $\{z_1,\ldots,z_{\binom{k}{2}}\}$, with each $z_j$ joined to a unique pair of $y_i$?

open Filter Asymptotics

def cliqueSubdivision (k : ℕ) : SimpleGraph (Fin k ⊕ Set.powersetCard (Fin k) 2) where
  Adj x y :=
    match x, y with
    | Sum.inl i, Sum.inr p => i ∈ (p : Finset (Fin k))
    | Sum.inr p, Sum.inl i => i ∈ (p : Finset (Fin k))
    | _, _ => False
  symm := by
    constructor
    intro x y h
    cases x <;> cases y <;> simp_all
  loopless := by
    constructor
    intro x
    cases x <;> simp

theorem erdos_32231 :
    ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ (SimpleGraph.extremalNumber n (cliqueSubdivision k) : ℝ)) =O[atTop]
        fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 - c) := by
  sorry
